text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Our tumultuous summer camp, marked
by
Matikanefukukitaru's mad pursuit of
good luck,
has come to a close.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much, Trainer! I had a
miraculous
time, thanks to your support!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Actually, there's one more thing I want
to ask
you. I tried plucking flower petals
to predict my
future a minute ago.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"I will succeed in the Kikuka Sho," "I
won't
succeed." You know, that kind of
thing.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
And you know what? The last petal told
me I'll
succeed!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I thought so too... But once I saw the
carnage
wrought on the chrysanthemum
petals by my
hands, I started to think
otherwise...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
So, what's the final result? A good omen
or a bad
one? I'm not sure...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We still don't know the answer—but our
exciting
and nerve-racking path toward
the fall Classics
continues.
